import struct,hashlib
data=open("/var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/svcx2","rb").read()
off=8; n=struct.unpack(">I",data[4:8])[0]; sl=None
for i in range(n):
    ct,cs,o,sz,a=struct.unpack(">IIIII",data[off:off+20]); off+=20
    if cs==0x80000002: sl=data[o:o+sz]; break
nc=struct.unpack("<I",sl[16:20])[0]; off=32
for _ in range(nc):
    cmd,sz=struct.unpack("<II",sl[off:off+8])
    if cmd==0x1d:
        do,ds=struct.unpack("<II",sl[off+8:off+16]); bl=sl[do:do+ds]
        mm,ll,c=struct.unpack(">III",bl[:12])
        for i in range(c):
            t,o=struct.unpack(">II",bl[12+i*8:20+i*8])
            if t==0:
                cd=bl[o:o+ll]
                io=struct.unpack(">I",cd[20:24])[0]
                ident=cd[io:cd.find(b"\x00",io)]
                print("ident:",ident)
                print("sha1:",hashlib.sha1(cd).hexdigest())
    off+=sz
PYEOF
